title: Bird Of Prey (Highlight Reel Today)
style: festival electronic pop, 138 BPM, big synth drop chorus, paddle-pop SFX, male and female duet, sport-anthem energy, anthemic bass build, bright lead synth, jump-shot vibe, viral hook, festival drop, hooky earworm, sing-along, stadium energy
lyrics:
[Intro — slow build, single paddle pop, then BIG synth drop]
Bird of prey.
Bird of prey.
You won't see this coming.
[bass drop]

[Verse 1 — male lead, festival anthem swagger]
You drop me cross, I read the angle, I'm gone
Two steps left, leaping past the safety zone
I'm in the AIR while your ball is in transit
Volley it down before it even touches the line, witness

[Pre-Chorus — chant, fast]
Skip the line, jump the line
Land outside, that's the design
Volley high before it lands
Bird of prey, in your hands

[Chorus — festival anthem hook]
BIRD OF PREY! (Cross-court, get out the way!)
BIRD OF PREY! (Around the line, into the air!)
BIRD OF PREY! (You didn't see me coming there!)
BIRD OF PREY! (Highlight reel today!)

[Verse 2 — female lead, sharp]
Most players think the court is two dimensions, flat
The pro adds a THIRD dimension — the JUMP — like a cat
Step BEFORE the bounce, paddle face down low
Ball hits the deck before they even know

[Pre-Chorus]
Skip the line, jump the line
Land outside, that's the design
Volley high before it lands
Bird of prey, in your hands

[Chorus]
BIRD OF PREY! (Cross-court, get out the way!)
BIRD OF PREY! (Around the line, into the air!)
BIRD OF PREY! (You didn't see me coming there!)
BIRD OF PREY! (Highlight reel today!)

[Bridge — slow, instructional]
Wait for the cross-court drop, telegraph the angle
Step BEFORE the bounce, jump the safety tangle
Land OUTSIDE the line, paddle pointing down
Ball hits the deck before they turn around

[Verse 3 — duet, fast]
[male] You dropped it cross
[female] I read the spin
[male] Stepped around the line
[female] Jumped right in
[male] Volleyed it down
[female] Ball never bounced
[both] BIRD OF PREY! Game point announced!

[Final Chorus — biggest drop]
BIRD OF PREY! (Cross-court, get out the way!)
BIRD OF PREY! (Around the line, into the air!)
BIRD OF PREY! (Game over, paddle in the air!)
BIRD OF PREY! Highlight reel today!

[Outro — commentator, awe]
That…
was a bird of prey.
Top ten plays.
Don't drop it cross-court to her again.
